english: Haa~.\nHow long will this journey go on, I wonder...

Well, yeah, lots happened...
Right.
'We came from another world' -\nat first I thought, are they crazy? But...
Since we're the ones stuck in another world now...\nI have no choice but to believe...
That's true, but...
Most everyone from the other world is nice,\nso it's been a really fun journey.
I-I'm not traveling to make friends or anything!

Right...

Louise-san...
...Yes! Right.

Miss Westwood...
